verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents compile-time type checking of Angular templates. The first-party docs cover TypeScript usage, CLI commands and AOT builds, but none of them say template expressions are type-checked. The only on-topic item is an Angular 2-era community report that typos in {{variables}} produced no compile-time error. With no vendor claim to contradict, that is not a dispute, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get compile-time type checking inside my component templates, not just script blocks
